_comment: Pin/peripheral VALIDATION RULES (POLICY) — deliberately a SEPARATE set from the build policy.json (issue alplabai/alp-sdk#235). Silicon FACTS (which pad carries which signal) live in the per-silicon pinmux METADATA; the RULES (what counts as a conflict, how severe, what's allowlisted) live here. Different owner, different lifecycle. The rule engine reads pinmux + this -> diagnostics + a validation source for the CLI/extension.
